args.content:
Hawaii Vacation Packing List
June 10-20, 2024

Essential Items:
- Valid ID/Passport
- Travel insurance documents
- Flight tickets/boarding passes (digital or printed)
- Hotel reservation confirmations
- Credit cards and cash
- Phone and charger
- Camera and charger
- Portable power bank

Clothing:
- Swimwear (at least 2-3 sets)
- Lightweight, breathable clothing
- Casual outfits for dinners and sightseeing
- Light jacket or sweater for cooler evenings
- Comfortable walking shoes
- Water shoes or reef walkers for snorkeling
- Flip-flops or sandals
- Hat with wide brim for sun protection
- Sunglasses

Beach & Water Activities:
- Beach towel
- Beach bag
- Waterproof phone case
- Snorkeling gear (mask, snorkel, fins)
- Underwater camera or GoPro
- Rash guard or swim shirt for sun protection

Sun Protection:
- High SPF sunscreen (reef-safe)
- After-sun lotion or aloe vera gel
- Lip balm with SPF

Hiking & Outdoor Activities:
- Hiking boots or sturdy shoes
- Lightweight hiking pants/shorts
- Moisture-wicking t-shirts
- Small backpack for day hikes
- Water bottle or hydration pack
- Trail snacks

Health & Personal Care:
- Prescription medications
- Basic first aid kit
- Motion sickness medication
- Insect repellent
- Toiletries
- Hand sanitizer
- Face masks (if required)

Electronics:
- Universal power adapter
- Headphones
- Laptop/tablet (if needed for work)

Miscellaneous:
- Reusable shopping bags
- Small umbrella or rain jacket
- Travel guidebook or downloaded maps
- Laundry bag for wet/swimsuits
- Ziplock bags for electronics protection
